name: Sheoldred
description: Sheoldred, the Whispering One, is the praetor of the black faction of New Phyrexia who led the invasion of Dominaria.

summary.text: Sheoldred, the Whispering One, is the praetor of the black faction of New Phyrexia who led the invasion of Dominaria.

bio.text: She earned her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other, and took control of the Dross Pits after outsmarting Roxith.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain, after which Sheoldred served Norn in the multiversal invasions.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She arrived in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria and was rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra, then mass-produced sleeper agents, resurrected Ertai and compleated Ajani Goldmane.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At the Battle of the Mana Rig she attacked on a dragon engine and captured Karn.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A Planar Bridge carried Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Rig, and Tezzeret carried her back to her lair in the Dross Pits.

citations.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She then moved against Elesh Norn and allied with Urabrask's rebellion, so Norn declared her an apostate and Ajani captured her.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Brought before Norn, she was decapitated by Ajani, the first known death of a New Phyrexian praetor.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

status.text: Sheoldred is dead, executed by Ajani on Elesh Norn's order.

citations.text: "Sheoldred", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rona pilots a dragon engine and Sheoldred affixes her torso to one during the Second Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred affixed her humanoid torso to a dragon engine for the Battle of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon engines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Factionalizing and the Castes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn flees to Mirrodin as the oil takes hold, later worshipped as Father of Machines and trapped in his own mind as Mirrodin becomes New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Karn retreated to Mirrodin's Core , being worshipped as the new Father of Machines

citation.text: "Karn", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn gains influence, conquering Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains.
timeline.quote: Slowly, Elesh Norn gained more influence, even in the furnace layers, effectively conquering Urabrask 's and Sheoldred 's domains.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth is captured and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum, from which he escapes changed.
timeline.quote: He was sent to the Dross Pits and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred takes control of the Dross Pits after deceiving Roxith.
timeline.quote: after falling for Sheoldred's deception, she took control of it

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn took control over the domains of Urabask and Sheoldred

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Domination of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred earns her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other.
timeline.quote: She earned her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred outsmarts Roxith, who is killed when he fails to access one of her coffers, and establishes her territory in the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: She outsmarted Roxith when he failed to access one of her coffers and was killed.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Sheoldred's domain, and Sheoldred then serves Norn in the multiversal invasions.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred declares many worlds will bow to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first.

citation.text: Phyrexian Rager (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel and defeats two Society of Mishra acolytes, who warn him that Sheoldred welcomes him and that others are coming.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred welcomes you!

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn finds the Phyrexian staging ground, where acolytes compleat humans and Sheoldred hangs suspended.
timeline.quote: He'd found the staging ground of the Phyrexian invasion.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn fights through Sheoldred's worshippers on a bridge and reaches the praetor.
timeline.quote: Karn pushed himself to his feet and charged down the narrow stone bridge.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: When Karn touches Sheoldred, she whispers to him and he learns Phyrexian sleeper agents are hidden in every land of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexian sleeper agents lurked in every land in Dominaria

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: As Karn plants an incendiary device inside Sheoldred, Rona's magic paralyzes him.
timeline.quote: But his hand did not move.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona tells Karn the forces have evacuated to secondary staging areas, and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred split apart, dividing herself up in pieces.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Stenn is revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent who transforms himself into an antenna and transmits the false location to Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: He had converted his entire body into an antenna, Karn realized

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
timeline.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred rises on a dragon-engine body and demands the sylex from Karn, showing his plan to draw her out had worked.
timeline.quote: You have the sylex for me.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred rams the Mana Rig and her army swarms up her body onto the upper deck.
timeline.quote: slammed her chest into the Mana Rig's bow section like a battering ram.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred slams into the Mana Rig again, splits from her host body, reveals a stolen face and tells Karn the next step in evolution will be compleated.
timeline.quote: The next step in evolution will be compleated.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A scarlet Planar Bridge opens and carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: it . . . stole him away.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha declares she is coming for Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

citation.text: Radha, Coalition Warlord (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion the Golden Argosy returns carrying Astor, restored to his senses after centuries, and he fights his old foes again.
timeline.quote: the Golden Argosy returned, carrying Astor aboard

citation.text: "Astor", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Coalition clashes with Sheoldred's army at the Battle of the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: the two armies clashed at the Battle of the Mana Rig on Shiv

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Sheoldred reconstitutes Ertai, who takes control of the new academy at Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: Ertai was reconstituted by the dark sciences of Sheoldred

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira serves as a leader of the New Coalition and is present in the battle against Sheoldred at the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: served as one of its leaders

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Caves of Koilos Karn finds Sheoldred's staging ground and Rona collapses the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: Rona collapsed the cavern on Karn, incapacitating the golem

citation.text: "Karn", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn is captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred at the Battle of the Mana Rig and brought before Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: During the Battle of the Mana Rig , Karn was captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred.

citation.text: "Karn", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rona and Sheoldred stage the second invasion in the caves; Karn confronts Rona and buries him under rock.
timeline.quote: Rona was confronted by Karn, who managed to bury him under tons of rock.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Second Phyrexian Invasion begins in 4562 AR when Sheoldred arrives via the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: The Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria took place in 4562 AR

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Sheoldred and Phyrexian forces to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport Sheoldred and some Phyrexian forces to the plane of Dominaria

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bridge carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred allies with the Society of Mishra, Rona and a resurrected Ertai, raising an army of compleated Argivians and sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: The invasion began when Sheoldred , the Whispering One, allied with the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A month later Sheoldred returns with New Phyrexia's full might; hundreds of battles erupt across Dominaria.
timeline.quote: A month later, Sheoldred returned with the full might of New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred arrives in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria, recuperates, and is rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra.
timeline.quote: was discovered and rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred mass-produces sleeper agents, resurrects Ertai, and compleats Ajani Goldmane.
timeline.quote: resurrected Ertai , and compleated the planeswalker Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred leads the attack at the Battle of the Mana Rig on a dragon engine and captures Karn.
timeline.quote: captured Karn , returning him to New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret carries Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret carried Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion, Windgrace's Soul rises from the land to defend it.
timeline.quote: Windgrace's Soul rose from the land to defend it against the invaders

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred orders the killing of all survivors.
timeline.quote: "Leave no survivors.

citation.text: No Mercy (Dominaria Remastered, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tears apart Sheoldred's Coliseum with her last free breath.
timeline.quote: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.

citation.text: Nahiri's Sacrifice (Phyrexia: All Will Be One, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: She then became the Mother of Machines, the highest power in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Victorious". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred is sent to Dominaria to fetch Karn, whom Norn welcomes back as Father of Machines and introduces to Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn successfully sent Sheoldred to Dominaria in a large-scale infiltration to fetch Karn .

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Invasion plans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn's forces capture the rebelling Sheoldred and Norn has compleated Ajani execute her.
timeline.quote: Norn commanded the compleated planeswalker Ajani to execute Sheoldred, ending her rival's threat.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred travels to Dominaria to regain ancient artifacts.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred would travel to Dominaria, seeking to regain precious ancient artifacts and perhaps conquer the plane.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred retreats to New Phyrexia with Karn.
timeline.quote: bringing with her Karn .

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After conquering Mirrodin, Elesh Norn starts a civil war against the other praetors and emerges as sole power above New Phyrexia, evolving the Machine Orthodoxy into the Machine Legion.
timeline.quote: Emerging as the Mother of Machines and sole power above all of New Phyrexia

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred invades Dominaria with sleeper agents; Karn discovers her but is trapped in a cave-in.
timeline.quote: she was able to trap him in a cave-in

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Sheoldred on Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani is captured and unknowingly compleated as a sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: he was captured and unknowingly compleated as a sleeper agent

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Sheoldred on Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred moves against Elesh Norn and allies with Urabrask's rebellion; Norn declares her an apostate and Ajani captures her.
timeline.quote: Norn declared her an apostate, and she was later captured by Ajani.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brought before Norn, Sheoldred is decapitated by Ajani with his axe, the first known death of a New Phyrexian praetor.
timeline.quote: ordered Ajani to decapitate her with his axe

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser's corpse is unearthed by Sheoldred's troops and woven into a Memnite goliath that serves her against Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: The inventor's corpse was unearthed by Sheoldred 's troops and woven into the fabric of a new goliath Memnite

citation.text: "Venser", section "All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
timeline.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and he beheads her.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred warns that a world will bow to Phyrexia as Mirrodin did.
timeline.quote: As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia.

citation.text: Phyrexian Rager (March of the Machine Commander, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani executes the praetor Sheoldred on Norn's command.
timeline.quote: Ajani executed the praetor Sheoldred

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urabrask starts a rebellion against Norn.
timeline.quote: Urabrask started a rebellion against Norn's Phyrexia.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geth is assassinated and Sheoldred executed before the invasion.
timeline.quote: with Geth assassinated and Sheoldred executed long before the bulk of the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn, with Jin-Gitaxias, Sheoldred and Vorinclex, compleats Atraxa while Urabrask declines.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias , Sheoldred , and Vorinclex all agreed to join Elesh Norn's efforts, and Atraxa was born

citation.text: "Atraxa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians win and remake the plane as New Phyrexia, nine spheres each ruled by a praetor faction.
timeline.quote: The plane was fully seized and transformed into New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Creation of New Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred tricked Roxith into ceding control of the Flesh Sphere, and the Thanes carved out fiefdoms.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred tricked Roxith into ceding control.

citation.text: "Dross Pits", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred's Phyrexians overrun the Rig and Jhoira triggers its self-destruction; Phyrexia achieves its aims but with heavy losses.
timeline.quote: Jhoira triggered the Mana Rig to self-destruct

citation.text: "Mana Rig", section "Battle of the Mana Rig". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rona leads clandestine excavations in the Caves of Koilos and discovers the charred but living Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: discovered the charred but still living form of the Phyrexian praetor Sheoldred

citation.text: "Rona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rona restores Sheoldred's flesh and becomes her second-in-command in the Second Phyrexian Invasion; she bests Karn and attacks Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: She bested Karn in a direct confrontation

citation.text: "Rona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Battle of the Mana Rig, Sheoldred names Rona head of operations; the force regroups in Shiv's Cometia Crater.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred named Rona the new head of operations for the invasion.

citation.text: "Rona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Roxith plans to oust Sheoldred and Karn but fails and is torn apart by the astral coffer.
timeline.quote: a flurry of razors and shadows tore him to pieces

citation.text: "Roxith", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred continues Roxith's work, creating the Dross Pits; Roxith still lives and aids Urabrask's rebellion.
timeline.quote: He is one of the Thanes who aided Urabrask's rebellion against Elesh Norn .

citation.text: "Roxith", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Sheoldred is one of the Phyrexian Praetors

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: —Isila, Priest of Sheoldred

citation.text: Horrifying Revelation (Mirrodin Besieged, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Sheoldred, the thane that currently hold the tenuous position of Praetor

citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Steel Thanes". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: The seven thanes undeniably stand as the most powerful influences

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Steel Thanes
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Steel Thanes". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: Sheoldred is one of the seven Steel Thanes that struggle for power over black-aligned faction of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Getting to Know the Praetors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Named among the gods of New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: Elesh Norn, Sheoldred, Jin-Gitaxias

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia.

citation.text: Phyrexian Rager (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias, Sheoldred, and Vorinclex all agreed to join Elesh Norn's efforts, and Atraxa was born

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.
